transcript:
SA: Kvarn Kaffe, Sara här.
C: Hej Sara, it's Elin at Studio Norrsken, up in Umeå.
SA: Hi Elin! Is it cold up there yet?
C: Snow last week already. Anyway, coffee. Forty kilo of the Morning Filter, like last time.
SA: Forty kilo Morning Filter.
C: Hmm, wait. A few people asked for decaf. Maybe the Colombian decaf instead?
SA: The decaf instead of the Morning Filter?
C: Ja... no. No, you know what, forget the decaf, they can drink tea. Back to the Morning Filter.
SA: Okay, Morning Filter after all. Still forty?
C: Make it forty five. We have two new people starting in November.
SA: Forty five, noted.
C: Sorry for the back and forth, it's been one of those days. The printer is on fire, almost literally.
SA: Ha, no problem at all. I'll email you the quote.
C: Tack, hej!
